supported_facts.claim: Adoption requires exact-candidate production-shaped p99 evidence; median-only evidence is insufficient.
Quartz prototype Q-17 reduced median latency by 18% on a 50-request synthetic sample, but tail latency was not measured.
An earlier Quartz build increased p99 latency by 9% on a bursty workload; the note does not establish whether it matches Q-17.

unknowns.unknown: Whether Q-17 is the exact release candidate.
Q-17 p99 latency under the production-shaped workload.
Whether the earlier build matches Q-17.

next_check: Identify the exact release candidate, then run it on the production-shaped workload and measure p99 against the current engine.
